entries.summary: Eberhard der Ältere und sein Bruder von Rosenberg (Rosinberg), Söhne Eberhards gen. der Rote, Eberhard der Jüngere und sein Bruder Arnold, Söhne Arnolds von Uissigheim (Vssinkein), verkaufen an die Abtei Bronnbach ihre benannten Güter in Steinbach bei Wenkheim mit der Gerichtsbarkeit daselbst um 184 Pfund Heller.
entries.latin: In nomine Domini amen. Ne ea que geruntur in tempore naturam temporis consequantur, expedit ea litterarum testimonio perhennari, eo propter. Nos Eberhardus maior, Conradus frater suus dictus de Bosberg, filii Eberhardi quondam dicti Rufi, Eberhardus minor et Arnoldus frater suus, filii quondam Arnoldi dicti de Essinhem, recognoscimus et tenore presentium notum facimus universis presentibus et futuris quod nos pari consensu et unanimi voluntate bona nostra infrascripta in villa dicta Stembach, iuxta [Wertheim?] sita, [Got]fridum servum nostrum ac universaliter omnia bona nostra in antedicta villa Stembach et in marchia eiusdem ville sita, culta et inculta, quesita et inquirenda, cum districtu et iurisdictione eiusdem ville tam in villa quam in campo vendidimus et tradidimus, vendimus et tradimus ipsis scriptis religiosis viris domino .. abbati et conventui monasterii in Brunnebach, ac in eosdem translata esse volumus pro centum et octoginta et quatuor libris hallensium numerate pecunie, proprietatis titulo perpetuo possidenda. Hec autem sunt bona, videlicet mansum quem colit Wernherus dictus Brockenloch annuatim solventem viii maltra siliginis, duo maltra tritici, duo maltra avene et unum pullum carnisp[rivii]. Item unam vineam quam colit dictus Wernh[erus] annuatim solventem [vj] den[arios] et ii pullos pasche. Item bona que possidet Irmengardis Blankep swester annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, unum maltrum avene, unum maltrum tritici et i pullum carnisp[rivii]. Item bona que possidet Gotfridus Gundolf annuatim solventia unum maltrum siliginis, maioris mensure unum maltrum avene. Item bona que possidet Heinricus dictus Eberhart annuatim solventia iii maltra siliginis et [i] maltrum avene maioris mensure et vii den[arios]. Item aream quam possidet Conradus dictus Angelus annuatim solventem unum maltrum siliginis et unum pullum Martii. Item aream quam idem possidet solventem annuatim vi den[arios] et unum pullum Martii. Item feodum quod possidet idem annuatim solvens [lx?] den[arios]. Item bona que possidet Waltherus [Glimens]vender annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, ii maltra avene et unum pullum carnisp[rivii]. Item aream quam possidet Conradus Kirchene annuatim solventem v den[arios]. Item aream quam possidet H. Hoveman annuatim solventem ii den[arios] et unum pullum Martii. Item bona que possidet Wolphramus Sengil solventia viii den[arios] et i pullum Martii. Item aream quam possidet C. frater suus solventem unum pullum Martii. Item bona que possidet C. Weideman annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, ii maltra avene et unum pullum carnisp[rivii]. Item bona que possidet Gotfridus Taschere annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, unum maltrum tritici, unum maltrum avene et unum pullum carnisp[rivii]. Item bona que possidet Hermanni Blanken[?] sun annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, ii maltra avene. Item aream et vineam quos possidet C. frater suus annuatim solventes xiii den[arios]. Item bona que possidet Gertrudis [Vllin?] annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, dimid[ium] maltrum avene et [lxxii?] den[arios]. Item bona que possidet H. [Vorchiche?] annuatim solventia ii maltra siliginis, dimid[ium] maltrum avene maioris mensure et xxxviii den[arios]. Item bona que possidet [Wirtiche?] annuatim solventia iiii maltra siliginis. Item bona que quondam colit Mechildis filia Alberti solventia annuatim xii den[arios] et unum pullum Martii. Item ortum quem possidet C. [Rise?] solventem ii den[arios]. Item agros quos possidet Conegundis [Genum?] solventes iiii den[arios]. Item bona que possidet Gotfridus [Wichiche?] annuatim solventia iii maltra siliginis, unum maltrum tritici, unum maltrum avene et unum pullum carnisp[rivii]. Item ortum quem possidet Conradus Winzurne solventem duos den[arios] annuatim. Ad warandiam quod vulgariter werschaft dicitur de dictis bonis memoratis religiosis .. abbati et conventui ad annum et diem, et sicut debent proprietarii de iure fieri consuevit, faciendam. Nos prefati Eberhardus et Conradus fratres, Eberhardus et Arnoldus fratres supradicti .. abbati et conventui nos per presentes obligamus, recognoscimus et publice presentibus protestamur dictam summam pecunie, scilicet centum octoginta libras et quatuor libras hallensium in numerata pecunia a prefatis .. abbate et conventu integre recepisse. In predictorum igitur omnium testimonium, argumentum evidens et munimen, sigilla nostra cum annotatione testium presentibus sunt appensa. Testes sunt Erkingerus de [Hannes?]heim, Conradus de Essinhem, Arnoldus dictus Bloche milites, Eberhardus de Randersacker, dominus Eberhardus abbas, Heroldus cellerarius, Andreas mag[ister] [c...], Dytherus custos, Gotfridus prepositus monachi Brunnebach, et alii quamplures fidedigni. Datum anno Domini M°CCC°V°, VIII kalendas Novembris.
entries.english: In the name of the Lord, amen. So that what is done in time may not follow the nature of time, it is expedient that it be made perpetual by the testimony of letters. For this reason we, Eberhard the Elder and Conrad his brother, called of Bosberg, sons of the late Eberhard called the Red, Eberhard the Younger and Arnold his brother, sons of the late Arnold called of Essinhem, acknowledge and by the tenor of these presents make known to all, present and future, that with equal consent and unanimous will we have sold and handed over our goods described below in the village called Stembach, situated near [Wertheim?], [Got]frid our serf, and universally all our goods in the aforesaid village of Stembach and in the boundaries of the same village, cultivated and uncultivated, acquired and to be acquired, with the jurisdiction and judicial authority of the same village, both in the village and in the field, to the said religious men, the lord .. abbot and the convent of the monastery in Bronnbach, and we wish them to be transferred to them for one hundred and eighty and four pounds of Heller in counted money, to be held in perpetual ownership. These are the goods, namely: the farm (mansus) which Wernher called Brockenloch holds, paying annually 8 malters of rye, two malters of wheat, two malters of oats and one Shrovetide hen. Likewise a vineyard which the said Wernher holds, paying annually [6] pennies and two Easter hens. Likewise the goods held by Irmengard, Blanke's sister, paying annually two malters of rye, one malter of oats, one malter of wheat and one Shrovetide hen. Likewise the goods held by Gotfrid Gundolf, paying annually one malter of rye and one malter of oats in the larger measure. Likewise the goods held by Heinrich called Eberhart, paying annually three malters of rye and [one] malter of oats in the larger measure and 7 pennies. Likewise a plot (area) held by Conrad called Angelus, paying annually one malter of rye and one March hen. Likewise a plot held by the same, paying annually 6 pennies and one March hen. Likewise a fief held by the same, paying annually [60?] pennies. Likewise the goods held by Walther [Glimens]vender, paying annually two malters of rye, two malters of oats and one Shrovetide hen. Likewise a plot held by Conrad Kirchene, paying annually 5 pennies. Likewise a plot held by H. Hoveman, paying annually 2 pennies and one March hen. Likewise the goods held by Wolfram Sengil, paying 8 pennies and one March hen. Likewise a plot held by C., his brother, paying one March hen. Likewise the goods held by C. Weideman, paying annually two malters of rye, two malters of oats and one Shrovetide hen. Likewise the goods held by Gotfrid Taschere, paying annually two malters of rye, one malter of wheat, one malter of oats and one Shrovetide hen. Likewise the goods held by the son of Hermann Blanke[?], paying annually two malters of rye and two malters of oats. Likewise a plot and a vineyard held by C., his brother, paying annually 13 pennies. Likewise the goods held by Gertrud [Vllin?], paying annually two malters of rye, half a malter of oats and [72?] pennies. Likewise the goods held by H. [Vorchiche?], paying annually two malters of rye, half a malter of oats in the larger measure and 38 pennies. Likewise the goods held by [Wirtiche?], paying annually four malters of rye. Likewise the goods which Mechthild, daughter of Albert, formerly held, paying annually 12 pennies and one March hen. Likewise a garden held by C. [Rise?], paying 2 pennies. Likewise fields held by Kunigunde [Genum?], paying 4 pennies. Likewise the goods held by Gotfrid [Wichiche?], paying annually three malters of rye, one malter of wheat, one malter of oats and one Shrovetide hen. Likewise a garden held by Conrad Winzurne, paying annually two pennies. For warranty, which is commonly called werschaft, concerning the said goods, to be rendered to the aforementioned religious, the .. abbot and the convent, for a year and a day, as is customary to be done by right on the part of owners: we, the aforesaid brothers Eberhard and Conrad, and Eberhard and Arnold, the aforementioned brothers, bind ourselves by these presents to the .. abbot and the convent, acknowledge, and publicly declare by these presents that we have received in full from the aforesaid .. abbot and convent the said sum of money, namely one hundred and eighty pounds and four pounds of Heller in counted money. In testimony of all the aforesaid, as clear proof and safeguard, our seals have been appended to these presents with the listing of witnesses. Witnesses are: Erkinger of [Hannes?]heim, Conrad of Essinhem, Arnold called Bloche, knights, Eberhard of Randersacker, the lord Eberhard abbot, Herold the cellarer, Andreas master [...], Dytherus the custodian, Gotfrid the provost, monks of Bronnbach, and many other trustworthy persons. Given in the year of the Lord 1305, on the 8th day before the Kalends of November [25 October].
facts: Eberhard von Rosenberg der Ältere, Konrad von Rosenberg, Eberhard von Uissigheim der Jüngere and Arnold sold their goods in Steinbach near Wenkheim, with the jurisdiction there, to Bronnbach Abbey.

Eberhard von Rosenberg der Ältere, Konrad von Rosenberg, Eberhard von Uissigheim der Jüngere and Arnold bound themselves to provide warranty (werschaft) for the goods to Bronnbach Abbey for a year and a day.
Eberhard von Rosenberg der Ältere, Konrad von Rosenberg, Eberhard von Uissigheim der Jüngere and Arnold appended their seals to the charter.
